blocks.title: Feature Update: Social Options Menu: Text Chat Settings
blocks.body:
New Options

- Group Text Chat - On / Off
- Team Text Chat - On / Off
- Match Text Chat - On / Off
- General Text Chat - On / Off
blocks.dev: Players will now have the ability to turn off text chat individually for Group, Team, Match and General chat channels effectively muting them separately. These options can be found within Text Chat settings on the Social Options menu.
